messages:
lee: quick sync 1: PM wants a "per-model sensitivity" row in cost dashboard. show how swapping model/quantization/routing affects $/1000 tokens.
nina: short version: compute baseline unit_cost per-model and then deltas for simulated variants.
rachel: are we simulating routing policies too? e.g., route->cheap-variant fallback on high latency. that changes effective token mix.
lee: yes. use two dims: model_variant (quant/size) and routing_policy (prefer-latency, prefer-cost, sticky). UI should let you toggle both and show projected cost delta.
devrel-omar: product note: customers ask for "what-if" when we suggest quantization. they want confidence intervals.
nina: confidence from sample variance of recent tokens + cache-hit uncertainty. show +/- one sigma.
lee: API question: do we do this in the dashboard client (fetch raw samples + compute) or server-side (precompute unit costs and simulated joins)? performance tradeoffs.
rachel: client-side heavy for big tenants. prefer server-side endpoint that returns baseline + sims. keep payload small.
nina: proposed endpoint: GET /api/v1/costs/experiments?tenant=X&routes=... returns [{model: "13b-int8", baseline_upt: "0.000012", sim:{"8bit": "-12%","fp16": "+0%"}, conf: "0.03"}] as compact strings.
devrel-omar: naming nit: use "upt" = unit_price_token or call it "usd_per_token"? keep stable.
lee: agree use usd_per_token. avoid abbreviations.
nina: infra: computing sims needs model_sku prices + quantization multipliers + routing mix. we can precompute multipliers (quantization factor) and apply to baseline. that is cheap.
rachel: but cache interplay is messy. if quant reduces token count (via EOS differences) we need sample-based estimate. heavy join again.
nina: workaround: flag two modes: "fast sim" uses multiplier heuristics, "sample sim" runs on sampled traces and is async. show ETA.
devrel-omar: UX: add a small inline "confidence" pill, and a download CSV for finance.
ops-bot: heads-up: analytics DB has nightly compaction at 1790000000; long queries may be delayed.
lee: rollout plan: alpha with fast-sim only for top 20 tenants behind feature flag. if alpha looks stable, add sample-sim later.
rachel: alerts: surface if simulated cost delta > 10% AND confidence high -> trigger a "routing suggestion" banner in console.
nina: also add quota safety: when simulation shows cost increase, warn about quota impact and suggest throttles.
devrel-omar: add example copy for console: "Switching to 8-bit reduces model cost by ~12% (est.). Confidence: medium. Run sample-sim for higher fidelity."
lee: owner matrix: nina -> sim engine + endpoint, rachel -> cache heuristics + sampling, devrel-omar -> messaging + CSV, lee -> feature flag + rollout.
nina: estimate: 3 days + infra review for sample pipeline. fast-sim MVP ~ 1.5 days.
nina: jot: telemetry join key = (tenant, route, model_sku, minute). keep consistent.
nina: small API contract detail: return all numbers as strings to avoid float precision surprises in JS.
rachel: good call. keeps JSON small too.
devrel-omar: :thumbsup: will draft copy.
ops-bot: ticket created COST-7804 for per-model sensitivity feature.
lee: ok, sync tomorrow 11:00 to lock alpha scope. thanks.
